description: T-5123 (SPEC-0039 E6, hand shape): after one delete_row of rows 4-7 (count 4), every data row of a table with a calculated column, does the table keep the column's formula (the engine keeps it)? insert_row 4, at the kept data row, then grows the table by a row (t4692-insert-row-first-data), which a calculated column fills (t4274-calc-column-insert-row-3). Sales on S!B3:D7 (header B3:D3 Region/Qty/Dbl, data rows 4-7 Qty 1,2,4,8; Dbl is a calculated column, calculatedColumnFormula Sales[[#This Row],[Qty]]*2, stored in D4:D7), S!C10 99 below it. Sheet F reads sheet rows 4 and 5 through whole-column references the edits do not move: A1 =ROWS(Sales), A2 =FORMULATEXT(INDEX(S!D:D,4)), A3 =ISFORMULA(INDEX(S!D:D,4)), A4 =FORMULATEXT(INDEX(S!D:D,5)), A5 =ISFORMULA(INDEX(S!D:D,5)), A6 =SUM(Sales[Dbl]).
